messages:
Noah: Quick heads up  EuroBank POC next Tue. They asked for a lightweight SE packet: an SSE-based streaming example (they prefer SSE for easy mobile/browser integration), a Python streaming snippet that demonstrates function/tool calls and emits NDJSON lines for downstream ETL, a REST fallback, a short security Q&A, and a pricing sketch comparing hosted streaming vs Dedicated 2G commit. Who can take each piece?

Zara: I can own the Python examples + README. SSE is finewe should show both SSE (EventSource) and a small requests-based poll fallback for older infra. Also include a checksum/header to detect truncated NDJSON lines.

Devon: I'll do pricing and the POC runbook. Important to show cost per 1M tokens for hosted streaming, the amortized token cost for Dedicated 2G, and a simple throughput test plan (10 editors x 2 minutes). I'll include 3-month vs 12-month commit numbers.

Maya: I'll draft the short security answers. Key Qs they flagged in their RFQ: are prompts stored; can we disable function-call payload logging; BYOK/KMS support; region locks; retention & immediate deletion API; subprocessors. Please drop the exact form answers I should paste.

Zara: Python SSE sketch (compact):

```py
# client: SSE + NDJSON lines
import sseclient
import requests

resp = requests.get('https://stream.redwood.example/v1/stream', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+API_KEY}, stream=True)
client = sseclient.SSEClient(resp)
for event in client.events():
    line = event.data.strip()  # NDJSON: one JSON object per line
    # quick checksum header example: X-Chunk-Checksum in event.id
    try:
        obj = json.loads(line)
        validate_schema(obj)  # server schema validation recommended
    except Exception as e:
        # emit repaired placeholder so ETL doesn't break
        print(json.dumps({'error':'malformed','raw':line}))
```

Zara: For function calling pattern, show the model emitting a function request event; client returns result via a side POST and the stream resumes. Minimal flow: 1) stream event: FUNCTION_CALL {id,name,args} 2) client POST /function-result?id=.. body=.. 3) server resumes generation and emits NDJSON output lines.

Devon: For REST fallback: example curl to synchronously request a non-streamed response and post-process JSON. Also include a small local harness command to simulate SSE with a token generator: `docker run --rm redwood/poc-sse --scenario=edits --concurrency=5`.

Maya: Security draft bullets: prompts are not persisted by default; transient debug logs can contain masked snippets for a short retention window for hosted service; function-call payload logging can be disabled per-route; we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in Private and enterprise-hosted KMS integrations; region locks and Private VPC deployments supported; retention configurable up to 36 months and immediate deletion via enterprise deletion API; subprocessors list available in legal portal. I'll flag any item needing legal or product security review.

Noah: provision-bot will spin up a demo env. Please keep the one-pager concise. Two asks: (1) Zara, drop the example repo link and a one-page code snippet for the SE to copy into their sandbox. (2) Devon, include a tiny SLA comparison (hosted vs Dedicated) and rollback plan for migrations.

provision-bot: POC environment provisioned: id=eurobank-poc-1799991234, url=https://console.redwood.example/poc/eurobank-poc-1799991234, creds=vault:eurobank/poc

Zara: Additional note: recommend adding a small integrity header (e.g., event.id checksum) so client can detect truncated NDJSON lines and request a replay from last-good-id. I'll include a small repair utility in the repo that reassembles broken JSON chunks.

Devon: Pricing highlights (draft): hosted streaming unit price expressed per 1M input+output tokens for discussion; Dedicated 2G commit monthly price with estimated sustained throughput (tokens/sec) and percent cost reduction at scale (approx 40-60% beyond 10M tokens/month). I'll put concrete numbers in the one-pager pending finance review. Also include sensitivity to average sequence length (2k vs 5k tokens).

Maya: Also add a canned sentence for customers: "We can sign a targeted DPA and support additional jurisdictional controls via Private deployment or region-locked hosted tenancy." Flag for legal.

Zara: Action items before EOD: push repo with SSE sample, NDJSON schema, repair CLI, and short README. I'll include a small JS EventSource browser snippet too.

Devon: I'll draft the pricing table and runbook: 1) local SSE test, 2) hosted POC for latency demo, 3) switch traffic to Dedicated via routing tag, 4) validate throughput, 5) optional Private deployment for residency needs. Include rollback steps to re-route to hosted.

Maya: I'll assemble the short security answers doc and attach the subprocessors link once I have the latest from legal. Looping legal if needed.

Noah: Great. Let's review the one-pager tomorrow 9am CET. Ping me directly for any pricing/legal escalations. :rocket:
